# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-09-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (8,13,21,34) contracts tightly on 5‑minute bars, a subsequent break with above‑average volume signals an imminent expansion move. This captures the compression‑to‑expansion transition, a structural edge distinct from existing ribbon‑ride setups that trade after a reclaim or rejection.

## Mechanism

Calculate the 8,13,21,34 EMA on 5‑minute bars. Compute ribbon_width = max(EMA) – min(EMA). If ribbon_width < 0.15×ATR(14) for three consecutive bars and the next bar closes above the highest EMA with volume > 1.3× the average 5‑minute volume, enter long; reverse for short when close below lowest EMA with same volume condition. Exit: stop at the opposite ribbon extreme (lowest EMA for long, highest EMA for short); TP1 at 2.0 R; runner trails using a premium‑stop of 20% of ATR. Regime filter: only consider entries when VIX < 14 and time between 11:00‑13:00 ET; skip when VIX > 22.
